semantic_conflicts_found: prioritize accepts a scalar baseline while layer_drivers always contrasts against the current scored population; combined, they describe two different comparisons
a scalar baseline has no layer profile, so additive attribution against it would have to be invented
prioritize clips gap and stable_gap at zero while layer_drivers keeps signed deltas
penalty_mass (sum of 1-S) is not the priority index and must stay distinct
scored populations can differ between views and this is not disclosed
ScoreResult.log is the live mutable EventLog while ScoreResult.cases is a copy; they can diverge after scoring
score(derive=True) mutates the caller's log in place
the quantile_scale recipe recomputes its reference on whatever log it is applied to
ScoreResult.mode defaults to 'flat' while Norm.scoring_mode defaults to 'layer_balanced'
event_id_col is accepted but no accessor exposes event identities for witnesses
proposed_api_additions: wise.evidence subpackage: models, manifest, capture, calibration
